mostWorthwhile.text: Adding a story to the painting was most worthwhile: familiar remembered parts became a creature nobody had seen, making imagination feel like an act of combination.

leastWorthwhile.text: Placing the pigment was a necessary but uneventful preparation, and the resulting cave painting initially had little descriptive detail.

surprise.text: Finishing the imagined beast revealed another goal: colouring a sky of their own.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt entirely purposeless, although combining echo with memory produced a complete song faster than I expected.

continue.text: Yes. I would be curious to see what else the community creates independently; the imagined beast and painted sky made that direction appealing.
